method: All 18 main-course hole windows inspected against existing geometry and Caddee hole plans. Accepted boundaries follow visible sand at native 0.16 m pixels; local segmentation assisted tracing, followed by visual contour review. Closed grass islands are exclusions, connected turf notches follow the outer contour. Diagram geometry is never used for coordinates. Mutable WMS does not identify capture date. One metre interpretation uncertainty is distinct from unmeasured registration accuracy.
